title: Casa Pura Vida - East Nashville 3BR/3BA Cozy Home
description:
East Nashville vacation home | 3 bedroom, 3 bath house with hot tub-ready outdoor space, minutes to downtown Nashville, Broadway, and Riverside Village. Sleeps 9 with 5 beds, full kitchen, free WiFi, washer/dryer, dedicated workspace, and a quiet yoga nook. Perfect for families, groups, and bachelorette parties near Music City's best food and nightlife. One of Airbnb's most loved homes. Pura vida, Cheryl. Permit #2019013143

The space
This is a 3 BD/3BA home in beautiful East Nashville! There are 3 bedrooms - 1 King, 2 Queens ... and for groups of 7-9, a full/twin bunkbed and couch if needed.

Master A is located upstairs front of house and it features: king-sized platform bed brand new memory foam mattress. There are many windows to shower you with sunlight or you can close all of the curtains and sleep in. Your private bathroom features a spacious walk-in tile double-headed shower ... yes it does! Please feel free to use the open cabinet and all of the drawers for your belongings.  Hair dryer is provided. Step outside your room onto your private balcony and enjoy the neighborhood. There is a TV in your room with access to Netflix/Hulu/Prime. Massive closet spaces for all of your luggage and hangers for your clothing.

The upstairs Master B features a Queen Temperpedic Bed. This room has a TV.   Also includes a private bathroom with deep soaking tub and shower combo. To accommodate additional people over 6 - this room also has a full/twin combo bunk bed with memory foam mattresses.  *200 lbs on top / 350 lbs on bottom per manufacturer restrictions.

The 3rd bedroom is downstairs - Features a Queen bed with memory foam mattress.  French doors with curtain you can close for privacy from your other guests.  This room has a large closet.  There is a bathroom right across the hall with deep tub and shower combo and cabinet space and shelves for your belongings. This room also features a desk and chair - my favorite workspace.

Open concept Living, Dining and Kitchen - I love this space.  It's decorated with art from friends of mine, West Elm and World Market furniture and decor.  It has a rustic minimalist vibe.  The living room TV has Roku, Netflix, Hulu and Prime. There is a great selection of books, games and cards on the shelf downstairs that you are more than welcome to use during your stay! BONUS! I have a karaoke machine with 2 mics you can sing your heart out with your friends! 

Laundry - washer and dryer are located upstairs, includes a drying rack and iron for your use.

I am doing a little bit of redecorating to refresh paint, curtains and rugs in Feb so you’ll see some new photos go up early March 2025. ☺️

Guest access
Mi casa es su casa!! When i am out of town it’s your home too. I want you to feel at home as you are so welcome to kick back and relax.  You have full access to the entire home with a few locked closets we use for storage of my things. Full kitchen access - gas stove, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, tea kettle, toaster, and tons of cabinet space. Wifi and Amazon Firestick/Netflix available. The upstairs balcony and front porch are excellent spots for your morning coffee/evening drink. The only thing I ask is that you leave it the way you found it :)  As I live there when you do not. Please place all of your used towels in the laundry room.

PARKING INFORMATION:
PARKING IS ONLY THE ARC DRIVE IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE. It fits 2 small cars or small SUVs very tightly. Free street parking is also available. PLEASE DO NOT PARK IN OR BLOCK THE BACK NEIGHBOR’S DRIVEWAY.

Other things to note
BACHELORETTE GROUPS ARE WELCOME! 
I love love! ❤️  I have some bachelorette card games and even a karaoke machine ☺️

There are a few rules you should note before booking: 
- No glitter or confetti
-No pinning, tacking or taping anything to anything - this is important as it destroys my paint and this is my home. I have a cork board in the kitchen you are welcome to use. 
Glitter or confetti will be an additional $250 cleaning fee on top of the $120 as it is very hard and time consuming to clean. Taping things to the wall has caused a lot of damage so that’s why i want you all to know upfront since this is my actual home and appreciate the understanding 🫶
- No alcohol under 21, and no drugs permitted. 
- No parties are allowed at my house including people not staying at the house are not allowed in the house ever.  This is a liability issue. If violation occurs you will immediately forfeit your security deposit.
-Please keep your pets on a leash at all times and do not allow them to climb or sit on the furniture.
